scenes.title: Hospital letter
scenes.caption: An ear, nose and throat appointment.
scenes.say: This letter is from St Anne's Hospital. It's an appointment at the ear, nose and throat clinic, about hearing loss in one ear.

scenes.title: When and where
scenes.caption: Tuesday 8 December 2026, Clinic 4, Level 2.
scenes.say: The appointment is on Tuesday the eighth of December, at twenty to eleven. Go to Clinic 4, Level 2, in the Blue Zone.

scenes.title: Allow time
scenes.caption: There is a hearing test first.
scenes.say: Allow up to two hours. There's a hearing test before you see the doctor, so don't plan anything tight afterwards.

scenes.title: Before you come
scenes.caption: No ear drops for one week beforehand.
scenes.say: For one week before, don't use any ear drops. Bring a list of your medicines, and your reading glasses if you need them.

picture.heading: BEFORE YOU COME
items: No ear drops for a week

scenes.title: Getting there
scenes.caption: Parking is limited. The number 12 bus stops outside.
scenes.say: Parking is limited. The number twelve bus stops right outside the main entrance. Need hospital transport? Ring at least three working days before.

scenes.title: Can't come?
scenes.caption: Ring as soon as you can, or you may go back to your GP.
scenes.say: If you can't come, ring the number on the letter as soon as you can. Miss it without telling them, and you may be sent back to your GP.
